d.ko: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.
d.en: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.
d.zh: 《Zombie Assault: Resurgence》是一款紧张刺激、动作感十足的俯视角射击游戏，具有深度的RPG元素。用独特的升级武器自定义装备，准备迎战成群的敌人。单人独闯或在最多4人的Co-op模式中组队作战！
